title: tooltips clarify outcomes
rule: When an icon or button initiates an action, include a tooltip that states the outcome without conflicting with the visible label.
pass_when: An action-initiating icon or button has a tooltip that states the outcome and does not conflict with the visible label.
fail_when: No tooltip on that control, or the tooltip conflicts with the visible label.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
